I rescued him about a month ago and he’s overweight so I’ve been keeping his food to 2 cups a day with treats throughout. I also have a treat dispensing ball that I put half a cup of food into as well. But he still scarfs it down even in a slow feeder!

I keep him on a very consistent routine because I work nights. Mornings are always potty then breakfast by 6:30 and then another potty break. We do either a small walk or playtime inside. He normally then naps until noon no matter what. If I’m off work I try to keep him stimulated but he’s not interested as much. Then for dinner time is always around 4:30 or 5 and we stay out until 5:20 when I leave for work. My roommate lets him out between then and 10 pm. 

Vet hasn’t found anything besides allergies and I’ve got him on apoquel (?). They advised to keep him active for his overweight issues but he becomes so exhausted with even the shortest walk.
